campObjects.name: Camp Tent
campObjects.description: Rested experience up to 5% of a level for everyone sitting nearby

item.name: Camp Tent
tooltip: Use: Builds a tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience to 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value. Requires a Campfire nearby. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

campObjects.name: Tanning Rack
campObjects.description: Makes certain Leatherworking reagents, and gives the Camp Tent bonus

item.name: Tanning Rack
tooltip: Use: Places a Tanning Rack that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

blueprint.name: Blueprint: Tanning Rack
tooltip: "Teaches you how to place a Tanning Rack at a campsite."

campObjects.name: Sewing Machine
campObjects.description: Needed for the most advanced Leatherworking recipes, and gives the Camp Tent bonus

item.name: Sewing Machine
tooltip: Use: Places a Sewing Machine usable for recipes that require it, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hr. (60 Min Cooldown)

blueprint.name: Blueprint: Sewing Machine
tooltip: "Teaches you how to place a Sewing Machine at a campsite."

legacyPerks.name: Performance Bonus
legacyPerks.description: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

legacyPerks.name: Working Overtime
legacyPerks.description: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 20%.

legacyPerks.name: Dedicated Study
legacyPerks.description: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.
